```{r}
                 plotly)
})
```
# Define working directory
```{r}
wd <- "./"
setwd(wd)
```
# Import data
```{r}
###
df <- readRDS("data/clean data/clean/clean/combine_group/baseline_all_combine.RData")
df_bl <- readRDS("data/clean data/clean/clean/combine_group/baseline_all_combine_bl.RData")
df_lm <- readRDS("data/clean data/clean/clean/combine_group/baseline_all_combine_lm.RData")

###
cmb_ori <- readRDS("data/clean data/general/comorbidities_01.RData")
df_sofa_ori <- readRDS("data/clean data/general/sofa_add.RData")
df_02_ori <- readRDS("data/clean data/general/f02.RData")
hos_reason <- read.xlsx("data/hos_reasons.xlsx")
df_antib_ori <- readRDS("data/clean data/general/anti_treat_prior_01.RData")

###
```
# Clean data
```{r}
###
### Filter IDs
cmb <- cmb_ori[which(cmb_ori$recordid %in% df$recordid),]
df_sofa <- df_sofa_ori[which(df_sofa_ori$recordid %in% df$recordid),]
df_02 <- df_02_ori[which(df_02_ori$recordid %in% df$recordid),]
df_antib <- df_antib_ori[which(df_antib_ori$recordid %in% df$recordid),]

### Combine treatment_group
cmb <- left_join(cmb, df[, c("recordid", "treatment_strategy")], by = "recordid")
df_sofa <- left_join(df_sofa, df[, c("recordid", "treatment_strategy")], by = "recordid")
df_02 <- left_join(df_02, df[, c("recordid", "treatment_strategy")], by = "recordid")
df_antib <- left_join(df_antib, df[, c("recordid", "treatment_strategy")], by = "recordid")

###
```
# Grouping admission reasons
```{r}
### Re-classify adm_reason (Luca)
### For df
adm_reason_01 <- matrix(NA, ncol = 1, nrow = nrow(df))

for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  if (!is.na(df$hpd_admreason[i])) {
  if (df$hpd_admreason[i] == "Infectious disease") {
    adm_reason_01[i,1] <- "Infectious disease"
  } else if (df$hpd_admreason[i] %in% c("Haematological disease", "Oncologic disorder")) {
    adm_reason_01[i,1] <- "Hae_Onc"
  } else if (df$hpd_admreason[i] %in% c("Orthopaedic condition", "Trauma", "Gynaecological disorder", "Genitourinary disorder")) {
    adm_reason_01[i,1] <- "Surgical"
  } else if (df$hpd_admreason[i] %in% c ("Cardiovascular condition", "Pulmonary disease", "Renal disorder", 
                                             "Gastrointestinal disorder", "Neurological disease", "Endocrine / Metabolic disorder", 
                                             "Dermatological disease", "Connective tissue disease")) {
    adm_reason_01[i,1] <- "Internal diseases"
  } else if (df$hpd_admreason[i] == "Undetermined") {
    adm_reason_01[i,1] <- "Others"
  } else {adm_reason_01[i,1] <- "Others"}
  } else {adm_reason_01[i,1] <- NA_character_}
}

# Combine into df
df <- df %>%
  mutate(adm_reason_01)

# Convert the variable type
df$adm_reason_01 <- as.character(df$adm_reason_01)

#-------------------------------------

###-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
### combine df
### For df
df_list <- list(df, df_02, df_sofa)

# Convert the `treatment_strategy` column to factor type in all data frames
df_list <- lapply(df_list, function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(treatment_strategy = as.factor(treatment_strategy))
})

df <- reduce(df_list, left_join, by = c("recordid", "treatment_strategy", "org_resistant", "WHO_group"))
```
